budget.title: Budget 2027: the Senate votes
budget.credit: Palazzo Madama · Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

updates.text: The session opens: 312 amendments on the table, the final vote is expected tonight.
The rent bonus survives: up to €2,000 a year for renters under 31.

last.name: Giulia R.
last.text: My landlord is not going to like this

updates.text: Pensions slow everything down: the vote moves to after 17:00.

last.name: Luca T.
last.text: My landlord is not going to like this

updates.text: The government calls a confidence vote: the result arrives within the hour.

last.name: Giulia R.
last.text: Finally some news on the rent bonus

updates.text: Approved: 112 yes, 76 no. The budget now goes back to the Chamber.
What changes for you, in 1 minute: our carousel is out.

last.name: Omar K.
last.text: Who else is here instead of studying?

gfvip.title: Grande Fratello Vip: the semifinal
gfvip.credit: Image from the web, personal prototype only

updates.text: The semifinal starts. It was moved from Friday to tonight, the final is on November 30.
Televote polls flip: Piera overtakes Varsi.
Andreas Müller is the third favourite for the final in the polls.

last.name: Marco B.
last.text: Who else is watching instead of studying?

updates.text: Live from the studio: the three nominated go to the televote, lines close at the end of the night.
Big moment in the House: the letter from home that everyone was waiting for.

last.name: Chiara P.
last.text: Andreas is so calm, I love him

updates.text: Televote closed. First result of the night: Andreas Müller goes straight to the final.

last.name: Chiara P.
last.text: Andreas is so calm, I love him

updates.text: Who is the next finalist? Vote in our poll and see what the community thinks.

last.name: Nina F.
last.text: Live from my sofa with my mum

sanremo.title: Sanremo 2027: the 24 Big
sanremo.credit: Teatro Ariston · Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 4.0

host.credit: Stefano De Martino · Wikimedia Commons, CC BY 3.0

updates.text: Official: Stefano De Martino is the host and artistic director of Sanremo 2027.
De Martino confirms the date: the 24 Big are announced on December 11 at 21:30 on Rai 1, during "Sarà Sanremo".
Rumours: Elodie, Achille Lauro, Mahmood and Geolier among the names. Nothing is confirmed yet.
The Festival runs from February 16 to 20, with a Eurovision night on the Thursday.
